title: 喵斯快跑原版联机！
content: 点击关于，加入喵斯兔官方群，与其他人联机游玩喵斯快跑！

title: 喵斯兔v1.5.1更新!
content: 新增“全局搜索”：可在一个界面同时搜索 MDMC、Euterpe 与 QQ群谱面，并统一展示结果。
content_en: Added Global Search: search MDMC, Euterpe, and QQ group charts from one page, with results shown together in a unified view.

title: 热重载自制谱模组更新！
content: 可以在游戏运行时往游戏添加/删除自制谱了？加入331568783喵斯兔交流群，获取最新测试版热重载自制谱模组！
content_en: You can add or delete custom charts while the game is running?Join the MuseDashTOOL communicate group:331568783,get the latest CustomAlbums which allows you to hotreload!

title: 紧急修复
content:
请在北京时间5月26日23：30以前使用了一键安装自制谱的用户，重新点击一键安装自制谱按键，否则会导致：
[Red]在自定义分组内打出成绩的谱面移出分组后成绩会消失[/Red]
如无影响或在这个时间之后一键安装的用户可忽视这条公告。
content_en:
Users who used 'One-Click Install Custom Charts' before 23:30 (UTC+8) on May 26, please click the button again to reinstall. Otherwise, it will cause:
[Red]Scores achieved on charts within a custom group to disappear after moving the chart out of the group.[/Red]
Users unaffected or who installed after this time can ignore this announcement.

title: 新大型曲包更新
content: 浅浅小饼干组织的，专为喵斯兔提供的长期多系列曲包『TEdgeool』更新！目前内含四个曲包，不定时更新，欢迎各位前往游玩！（更新至最新版本有惊喜！）
content_en: Organized by 'QianQianXiaoBingGan', the long-term multi-series song pack 'TEdgeool' exclusively for MuseDashTOOL has been updated! It currently contains four song packs and is updated periodically. Welcome to play! (There's a surprise if you update to the latest version!)

title: 热重载自制谱补丁更新
content: 修复了热重载的谱面demo预览播放会突然中断的问题，请前往mod下载重新下载一遍即可更新。
